Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are seeking a collaborative and versatile Fullstack Engineer to join our growing product team. In this role, you will be instrumental in building and scaling high-performance web applications that serve a global user base. You will contribute to both the sophisticated frontend interfaces and the robust backend microservices that power our platform. We value engineers who are lifelong learners, appreciate clean code, and thrive in an environment where technical excellence and team empathy go hand-in-hand.
 Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain responsive web applications using Angular, ensuring a seamless experience across all devices.
Architect and implement scalable backend services using Java and Kotlin, focusing on performance, reliability, and security.
Collaborate with product managers and designers to translate user needs into functional, high-quality technical solutions.
Participate in peer code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and facilitate knowledge sharing across the team.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues throughout the full software development lifecycle.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
 Required Qualifications
Proven professional experience in fullstack development.
Strong proficiency in Java and Kotlin for backend development.
Demonstrated expertise in building modern, modular frontend applications with Angular.
Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration.
Proficiency with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and version control systems like Git.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
